summary: EarthPulse SAR is an AI-powered platform that uses Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellite data from NASA and other Earth observation missions to monitor environmental changes on Earth's surface. The platform analyzes radar imagery to detect floods, land degradation, urban expansion, and other environmental transformations, then presents the results through an interactive dashboard with before-and-after visualizations, trend analysis, and location-based insights. By leveraging SAR technology, the system can provide reliable monitoring regardless of weather conditions or daylight availability, supporting researchers, decision-makers, and communities in understanding environmental change and improving sustainability efforts.
